items.title_en: Evidence of inconsistencies in evaluation process and selection of winners
items.title_zh: 评估过程与获胜者选择中的不一致证据
items.summary_en: Discrepancies in evaluation and winner selection in a competition raise questions about scoring integrity and reproducibility. The discussion underscores the need for transparent benchmarks, audit trails, and robust review processes.
items.summary_zh: 评估与获胜者选取过程中的不一致引发对评分公正性和可复现性的质疑。讨论强调需要透明的基准、可审计轨迹，以及健全的评审流程。

items.title_en: Mozilla: The state of open source AI
items.title_zh: Mozilla：开源 AI 的现状
items.summary_en: Open-source AI platforms are maturing, with new models, licensing debates, and governance challenges shaping the ecosystem. The piece benchmarks how open tooling stacks up against proprietary options and why safety, transparency, and community norms matter for long-term viability.
items.summary_zh: 开源 AI 正在走向成熟，新的模型、许可与治理挑战共同塑造生态。相较于商业垄断，开放工具链在安全性、透明度和社区规范方面的表现将决定其长期可用性与影响力。

items.title_en: Apple targets dozens of OpenAI employees with legal letters
items.title_zh: 苹果致函多名 OpenAI 员工
items.summary_en: Apple sent legal letters to a number of OpenAI employees, touching IP and contractual concerns tied to AI tooling usage. The move signals intensified corporate scrutiny over AI research and the boundaries of innovation, IP, and employment.
items.summary_zh: 苹果就 AI 工具使用相关的知识产权与合约事宜，对多名 OpenAI 员工发出法律函。此举凸显企业对 AI 研究的更强监管，以及创新、知识产权与雇佣关系之间的边界。

items.title_en: AWS: Inaccurate Estimated Billing Data – $1.7 billion
items.title_zh: AWS：估算账单数据不准确，涉额17亿美元
items.summary_en: Amazon Web Services disclosed inaccuracies in its estimated billing data, leading to charges totaling about $1.7B across customers. The incident highlights how cloud-cost visibility can fail at scale and underscores the need for robust auditing, refund mechanisms, and better tooling for cost governance in large cloud environments.
items.summary_zh: 云成本监控在大规模云环境中暴露出不足，估算账单数据存在不准确之处，涉案金额约17亿美元。此事凸显需要更强的成本可视化、审计与退款流程，并推动改进的成本管理工具与治理方法。

items.title_en: Ask HN: Any AWS billing issues known? Amazon forecast of 3 billion dollars
items.title_zh: Ask HN：是否有已知的 AWS 计费问题？亚马逊预测额为 30亿美元
items.summary_en: A discussion thread about known AWS billing issues and the discrepancy with a $3B forecast, highlighting concerns about forecast accuracy, billing transparency, and anomaly detection in cloud spending.
items.summary_zh: 讨论聚焦于 AWS 计费问题的已知情况与 30 亿美元预测之间的差异，凸显对预测准确性、计费透明度以及云支出异常检测的关注。

items.title_en: Minikotlin
items.title_zh: Minikotlin：极简 Kotlin 实现
items.summary_en: Minikotlin presents a compact, lightweight Kotlin subset or runtime, useful for embedding Kotlin-like semantics in constrained environments. It illustrates how language design trade-offs enable smaller footprints while retaining familiar syntax.
items.summary_zh: Minikotlin 展示了一个极简的 Kotlin 子集/运行时，适合在资源受限环境中嵌入 Kotlin 风格的语义。它展示了语言设计权衡如何在保持熟悉语法的同时实现更小的体积。

items.title_en: Kimi K3: Open Frontier Intelligence
items.title_zh: Kimi K3：开放前沿情报
items.summary_en: Kimi unveils K3 as an Open Frontier Intelligence platform, outlining its architecture and potential use cases in open data exploration. It emphasizes agent-driven workflows and scalable data access, signaling a push toward more transparent, configurable intelligence tooling.
items.summary_zh: Kimi 发表 K3，作为一个开放前沿情报平台，概述了其架构与在开放数据探索中的潜在应用场景。强调代理驱动的工作流与可扩展的数据访问，预示向更透明、可配置的情报工具迈进。

items.title_en: First atmosphere found on Earth-like planet in habitable zone of distant star
items.title_zh: 在遥远恒星的宜居带首次发现地球样行星的大气
items.summary_en: Astronomers detected atmospheric signals on an Earth-like planet in a distant star’s habitable zone, marking a milestone in characterizing rocky worlds beyond our solar system. The finding invigorates plans for future telescopes to search for biosignatures and assess habitability on exoplanets.
items.summary_zh: 天文学家在遥远恒星的宜居带内探测到地球样行星的大气信号，标志着对系外岩石行星表征的重大进展。此发现将推动未来望远镜在星际尺度上寻找生物征兆并评估宜居性。

items.title_en: A Road to Lisp: Which Lisp
items.title_zh: 走向 Lisp 的路：该选哪种 Lisp
items.summary_en: The post surveys the Lisp family—Common Lisp, Scheme, Clojure, and others—and offers guidance on choosing a flavor based on macro power, ecosystem, and project goals. It emphasizes practical considerations over historical purity.
items.summary_zh: 文章梳理 Lisp 家族的不同变体（如 Common Lisp、Scheme、Clojure 等），就宏系统、生态与项目目标等因素给出选型建议。强调实用性与生态成熟度往往比历史传统一味重要。

items.title_en: Show HN: Watch bots interact with an SSH honeypot in real time
items.title_zh: Show HN：看机器人与 SSH 蜜罐实时互动
items.summary_en: Live footage of bots interacting with an SSH honeypot reveals attacker automation patterns and defender signals in real time. The stream provides tangible lessons for threat hunting, anomaly detection, and hardened SSH configurations.
items.summary_zh: 实时演示显示机器人与 SSH 蜜罐的互动，揭示攻击者的自动化行为与防守信号。此直播为威胁猎杀、异常检测和 SSH 安全加固提供了具体的教训。

items.title_en: Three ways people respond to a problem (other than solving it)
items.title_zh: 除了真正解决问题之外，人们对问题的三种应对方式
items.summary_en: Three common non-solution responses to problems—avoidance, blame, and workaround-focused procrastination—which can derail teams. The piece offers perspectives on recognizing these patterns and steering efforts toward proactive problem-solving.
items.summary_zh: 三种对待问题但并非解决本身的常见行为：回避、指责与应急式拖延，可能拖累团队进度。文中点出识别这些模式的重要性，并提出将注意力引导回到积极解决问题的路径。

items.title_en: Multi-Primary Color Display Emerges as Next-Gen Color Reproduction Technology
items.title_zh: 多主色显示：下一代颜色重现技术
items.summary_en: Multi-primary color displays promise broader color gamuts by using more than RGB primaries, enabling richer and more accurate color reproduction. The tech faces calibration, energy and content ecosystem challenges but could redefine display quality for media and gaming.
items.summary_zh: 多主色显示通过使用不止 RGB 的原色来扩展色域，带来更丰富、准确的色彩再现。虽然在标定、能耗和内容生态等方面存在挑战，但有望改变媒体与游戏的显示质量。

items.title_en: Claude Code: Anatomy of a Misfeature
items.title_zh: Claude Code：误特性的解剖
items.summary_en: An examination of a misfeature in Claude Code, focusing on where AI-assisted code generation can misfire—whether through reliability gaps, safety blind spots, or unintended outputs. The piece argues for stronger guardrails and user controls when coding with AI.
items.summary_zh: 聚焦 Claude Code 的一个设计误区，分析 AI 辅助代码生成在可靠性、安全性或输出意外性方面的问题。强调需要加强防护边界与用户控制，以提升在编程场景中的安全性与可控性。

items.title_en: EEG shows brain can simultaneous encode two speech streams
items.title_zh: 脑电图显示大脑能同时编码两路语音
items.summary_en: Researchers used EEG to demonstrate that the brain can track two concurrent speech streams, indicating parallel encoding rather than strictly serial processing. This challenges simple models of auditory processing and could influence future hearing-aid design and multi-speech decoding systems.
items.summary_zh: 研究通过脑电图证明大脑能够同时跟踪两路语音信号，表明存在并行编码而非串行处理。这一发现挑战了简单的听觉处理模型，并可能推动未来助听器设计和多语音解码系统的发展。

items.title_en: Microsoft Comic Chat is now open source
items.title_zh: 微软 Comic Chat 现已开源
items.summary_en: Microsoft released the classic Comic Chat client as open source, reviving a piece of 1990s online chat UI and protocol. The release provides a sandbox for experimentation with vintage software, preserving artifacts and teaching UX evolution.
items.summary_zh: 微软将经典的 Comic Chat 客户端开源，重现了 1990 年代的在线聊天界面和协议。此次发布为复古软件的实验、保存与研究提供了机会，也揭示了聊天用户体验的演变。

items.title_en: AI Meets Cryptography 2: What AI Found in OpenVM's ZkVM
items.title_zh: AI 与 密码学 2：AI 在 OpenVM 的 ZkVM 中发现的内容
items.summary_en: AI-assisted analysis uncovers issues in OpenVM’s ZkVM, highlighting how AI can aid cryptographic tooling safety by surfacing bugs or design weaknesses.
items.summary_zh: AI 辅助分析揭示了 OpenVM 的 ZkVM 中的问题，展示了 AI 在密码学工具的安全性方面的潜在作用（如暴露漏洞或设计缺陷）。讨论了对零知识证明和安全计算的潜在影响。

items.title_en: I Owe My Life to the Commodore 64
items.title_zh: 我的人生全靠 Commodore 64
items.summary_en: A personal reminiscence about how the Commodore 64 shaped the author’s life and career in computing, illustrating the lasting influence of early machines on modern software culture.
items.summary_zh: 回忆 Commodore 64 如何塑造作者的计算生涯与兴趣，展示早期个人电脑对当代软件文化的深远影响。

items.title_en: Decoy Font
items.title_zh: Decoy 字体
items.summary_en: Decoy Font is an experimental typeface designed to confuse automated readers and OCR systems by mapping glyphs in unusual ways. It highlights typography’s impact on AI text detectors and reveals current recognition limits.
items.summary_zh: Decoy 字体是一种实验性字体，通过以异常的方式映射字形来混淆自动识别系统与 OCR。它揭示排版对 AI 文本检测的影响与当前识别能力的边界。

items.title_en: How Has Roman Concrete Lasted for Millennia? 1,900-Year-Old Latrine Offers Clues
items.title_zh: 罗马混凝土为何能持久千年？1900 年历史的厕所揭示线索
items.summary_en: An analysis of a 1,900-year-old Roman latrine reveals enduring durability due to a pozzolanic mix with volcanic ash that forms durable minerals in seawater. The findings offer lessons for modern, lower-carbon concretes and more durable infrastructure.
items.summary_zh: 对一座1900年历史的罗马厕所进行分析，揭示其混凝土耐久性源于掺入火山灰等火山灰质材料的火山灰质混合物，在海水环境中会形成耐久矿物。研究为现代低碳混凝土设计和长期基础设施耐久性提供启示。

items.title_en: Pebble Mega Update – July 2026
items.title_zh: Pebble 巨大更新：2026 年 7 月
items.summary_en: Pebble releases a comprehensive July 2026 Mega Update detailing major firmware and app ecosystem improvements, performance tweaks, and new features for Pebble devices.
items.summary_zh: Pebble 公布 2026 年 7 月的重大更新，涵盖固件、应用生态、性能优化和新功能，旨在提升设备使用体验。

items.title_en: Sony deletes more movies from the accounts of people who ‘bought’ them
items.title_zh: 索尼再次从购买者账户中删除多部电影
items.summary_en: Sony has removed additional titles from users’ digital libraries after purchase, prompting questions about ownership, DRM, and what it means to 'own' digital media. The incident spotlights ongoing tensions in rights, licensing, and user trust.
items.summary_zh: 索尼再次从已购买用户的数字库中删除多部电影，引发关于数字所有权、DRM 与所有权概念的讨论。此事凸显版权、许可与用户信任之间的张力。

items.title_en: VulnHunter: Capital One's agentic AI code security tool
items.title_zh: VulnHunter：Capital One 的主动式 AI 代码安全工具
items.summary_en: Capital One launches VulnHunter, an AI-driven tool that autonomously scans code for vulnerabilities, signaling a shift toward proactive, agentic security tooling. The approach could accelerate secure software delivery while raising questions about auditability and safety.
items.summary_zh: Capital One 推出 VulnHunter，一款能够自主扫描代码漏洞的 AI 驱动工具，标志着对主动化安全工具的推进。此举有望加速安全软件交付，但也对可审计性与安全性提出新挑战。

items.title_en: $100 AI Music Video: Claude Fable 5 vs. GPT-5.6 Sol
items.title_zh: 100美元AI音乐视频：Claude Fable 5 与 GPT-5.6 Sol
items.summary_en: A comparison of AI music video generation costs and capabilities, with Claude Fable 5 and GPT-5.6 Sol producing contenders.
items.summary_zh: 以 Claude Fable 5 和 GPT-5.6 Sol 为对手，比较低成本生成音乐视频的质量与成本。文章探讨创作 AI 在质量、规模与限制方面的表现。

items.title_en: LM Studio Bionic: the AI agent for open models
items.title_zh: LM Studio Bionic：面向开放模型的AI代理
items.summary_en: LM Studio launches Bionic, an AI agent framework designed to run with open models. It enables orchestration, tool use, and safety controls in an open-model ecosystem.
items.summary_zh: LM Studio 推出 Bionic，一套面向开放模型的 AI 代理框架，支持对开放模型的编排、工具调用及安全控制，推动开放模型生态的发展。

items.title_en: The lost joy of music piracy
items.title_zh: 音乐盗版的逝去乐趣
items.summary_en: Streaming turned music into a predictable, licensed product, draining the anarchic joy of early piracy. The piece reflects on how the pirate-era culture created camaraderie and discovery, and asks what we lose when access becomes commodified.
items.summary_zh: 流媒体让音乐变成可控的授权商品，削弱了早期盗版带来的狂热和社区感。本文回顾那段盗版文化如何塑造了发现与分享的乐趣，并讨论当下更易获取的市场会让我们错过哪些宝贵的文化体验。

items.title_en: OnePlus halts operations in USA and Europe
items.title_zh: OnePlus 在美国与欧洲暂停运营
items.summary_en: OnePlus halted operations in the US and Europe, signaling a strategic retreat amid regulatory, market, or supply-chain pressures. The move underscores how mid-market hardware brands navigate geopolitical tensions and post-pandemic demand shifts.
items.summary_zh: OnePlus 宣布在美国与欧洲暂停运营，背后或涉及监管、市场与供应链压力。此举反映中端硬件品牌在地缘政治紧张与后疫情需求变化中的策略调整。

items.title_en: PennyLane is an open-source quantum software platform for quantum
items.title_zh: PennyLane：开源量子软件平台
items.summary_en: PennyLane enables differentiable programming across quantum hardware and simulators, democratizing access to quantum machine learning and variational algorithms. Its open-source nature and framework integrations lower barriers to experimenting with quantum ML.
items.summary_zh: PennyLane 提供可在量子硬件与模拟器之间进行可微分编程的框架，使量子机器学习和变分算法更易接触。作为开源项目，良好的生态集成降低了入门与试验的门槛。

items.title_en: How Our Rust-to-Zig Rewrite Is Going
items.title_zh: 我们的 Rust 转 Zig 重写进展
items.summary_en: Progress update on rewriting a Rust codebase in Zig, detailing early results, design choices, and remaining hurdles. It outlines potential gains in memory safety, binary size, and cross-platform portability while acknowledging migration complexity.
items.summary_zh: 本文更新了将 Rust 代码库改写为 Zig 的进展，介绍关键设计取舍、初步成果与尚待解决的挑战。讨论了在内存安全、二进制大小和跨平台可移植性方面的潜在收益，同时也强调迁移的复杂性。

items.title_en: The human-in-the-loop is tired
items.title_zh: 人机协同中的在环机制已疲惫
items.summary_en: The piece argues that human-in-the-loop systems are reaching a fatigue point due to repetitive tasks and heavy cognitive load. It calls for redesigned tooling, clearer task boundaries, and smarter automation to keep humans in the loop where they add the most value.
items.summary_zh: 文章指出在环人机系统正因重复性任务和认知负荷过大而感到疲惫。呼吁改进工具、划分清晰任务边界，并通过更智能的自动化来让人类在最具价值的环节保持参与。

items.title_en: NotebookLM is now Gemini Notebook
items.title_zh: NotebookLM 现名为 Gemini Notebook
items.summary_en: Google rebrands NotebookLM as Gemini Notebook and ties it more closely to the Gemini AI ecosystem, signaling deeper integration for note-taking, research, and AI-assisted idea capture.
items.summary_zh: Google 将 NotebookLM 重命名为 Gemini Notebook，并与 Gemini AI 生态系统更紧密地整合，强化笔记、研究与 AI 辅助记录的能力。

items.title_en: The Little Book of Reinforcement Learning
items.title_zh: 强化学习小册子
items.summary_en: A compact, practical primer on reinforcement learning covers core ideas, common algorithms, and pitfalls with approachable explanations and examples for real-world use.
items.summary_zh: 这本简短的入门书系统讲解了强化学习的核心概念、常用算法及常见误区，配有易于理解的示例，帮助开发者在实际项目中落地 RL。

items.title_en: More Bounce to the Ounce – By Maciej Cegłowski
items.title_zh: More Bounce to the Ounce — Maciej Cegłowski 的回顾
items.summary_en: Maciej Cegłowski delivers a provocative take on the web’s future, privacy, and governance, challenging readers to rethink surveillance capitalism and digital resilience. The essay blends tech critique with a call to action for sustainable online ecosystems.
items.summary_zh: Maciej Cegłowski 对网络未来、隐私与治理提出挑衅性观点，促使读者重新思考监控资本主义与数字韧性。文章将技术批评与对可持续网络生态的行动呼吁结合在一起。

items.title_en: GrapheneOS recommended for domestic abuse victims
items.title_zh: GrapheneOS：家暴受害者的安全选择
items.summary_en: GrapheneOS is recommended for domestic-abuse victims due to its strong security, privacy controls, and app hardening that reduce risk when devices are under coercive control.
items.summary_zh: GrapheneOS 因具备强健的安全性、隐私控制和应用加固等特性，被推荐给家暴受害者，以降低在控制环境中被监控或数据暴露的风险。文章举例说明其对应用隔离与低数据回传等的实际保护作用。

items.title_en: Mathematics of Data Science
items.title_zh: 数据科学的数学基础
items.summary_en: The arXiv preprint surveys core mathematical themes in data science, including optimization, statistics, high-dimensional geometry, and generalization. It connects theory to practical algorithm design and highlights where intuition can mislead.
items.summary_zh: 这篇 arXiv 预印本梳理数据科学中的核心数学主题，如优化、统计、高维几何与泛化等，并将理论与实际算法设计联系起来，指出直觉可能误导的地方。

items.title_en: Immersive Linear Algebra Book with Interactive Figures (2015)
items.title_zh: 带交互图的沉浸式线性代数书（2015）
items.summary_en: Immersive Linear Algebra, a 2015 project, offers interactive figures to explore linear algebra concepts, foreshadowing the rise of web-based math visualization.
items.summary_zh: 2015 年的沉浸式线性代数书通过互动图形讲解概念，预示了网页化数学可视化的崛起。

items.title_en: US Corporate Insiders Are Selling Stocks at a Near Record Pace
items.title_zh: 美国企业内部人士接近历史高位的抛售股票
items.summary_en: Insider selling activity is at nearly record levels, suggesting caution about valuations or risk exposure among corporate insiders. The note discusses potential market implications and governance considerations.
items.summary_zh: 企业内部人士的卖出活跃度接近历史高位，反映对估值或风险敞口的谨慎态度。文章探讨对市场的潜在影响及治理层面的考量。

items.title_en: Detecting LLM-Generated Texts with “Classical” Machine Learning
items.title_zh: 用传统机器学习检测大语言模型生成文本
items.summary_en: Even with powerful LLMs, traditional machine learning classifiers can help detect AI-generated text using features like syntax patterns and punctuation. The approach often provides interpretable signals that complement neural detectors.
items.summary_zh: 即使面对强大的大语言模型，传统机器学习分类器也能通过句法模式、标点等特征识别 AI 生成文本，提供可解释的信号，常与神经检测相互补充。

items.title_en: The LLM Critics Are Right. I Use LLMs Anyway
items.title_zh: LLM 的批评者说得对，我仍然在使用 LLM
items.summary_en: The author acknowledges criticisms of LLMs but argues practical value justifies continued use, perhaps with safeguards and mindful expectations. It discusses balancing limitations with productive applications, and how to integrate LLMs responsibly.
items.summary_zh: 作者承认对 LLM 的批评，但认为在有保障和谨慎期望的前提下，仍然能从中获益，并讨论如何在实际应用中平衡局限性与生产力，以及负责任地使用 LLM。

items.title_en: Pushinka
items.title_zh: Pushinka
items.summary_en: Pushinka—the famous space-era pet cat linked to US-Soviet science history—offers a small, humanizing glimpse into the science-and-politics era that shaped Cold War tech culture.
items.summary_zh: Pushinka 是一只与美苏太空研究相关的著名猫咪，提供了对促成冷战科技文化的科学与政治交织的微观视角。

items.title_en: Helium escaping from atmosphere of nearby rocky exoplanet in a habitable zone
items.title_zh: 来自位于可居住带的近地系外岩行星大气中的氦逸散
items.summary_en: A science paper reports helium escape from the atmosphere of a nearby rocky exoplanet in the habitable zone. The finding informs atmospheric loss rates and has implications for the planet's potential habitability and evolution.
items.summary_zh: 一项科学论文报道在可居住带的近地系外岩质行星大气中氦逸散的发现，提供大气损失速率的线索并对该行星的潜在宜居性与演化产生影响。

items.title_en: Ente – Opening Our Books
items.title_zh: Ente：公开我们的账本
items.summary_en: Ente is opening its books to transparency, inviting public scrutiny of its finances and governance. The move could build trust and reveal how resources are allocated.
items.summary_zh: Ente 正在公开账本以实现透明化，邀请公众审阅财务与治理情况。此举有助于提升信任度，并揭示资源分配的细节。

items.title_en: CD sales growth outpaced vinyl in the first half of 2026
items.title_zh: 2026 年上半年 CD 销量增长领先于黑胶
items.summary_en: CD sales grew faster than vinyl in the first half of 2026, signaling a modest revival of physical media amid changing music consumption.
items.summary_zh: 2026 年上半年 CD 销量增速超过黑胶，显示实体媒介在音乐消费格局变化中出现小幅回暖。

items.title_en: 'Likweli': A new monkey species discovered in the Congo Basin
items.title_zh: 新猴种 Likweli：刚果盆地发现
items.summary_en: Researchers describe a new monkey species named Likweli in the Congo Basin, detailing distinctive traits and behaviors, with implications for conservation and primatology.
items.summary_zh: 研究人员在刚果盆地发现一种新猴种“Likweli”，描述其独特特征与行为，并强调其在生物多样性保护和灵长类研究中的意义。

items.title_en: US manufacturing employment is down, but each state has its own story
items.title_zh: 美国制造业就业下降，但各州各有故事
items.summary_en: US manufacturing employment has declined overall, yet state-level trends diverge due to automation, policy, and industry mix.
items.summary_zh: 美国制造业就业总体下降，但各州之间因自动化、政策与产业结构而呈现不同走向。文章分析区域差异及其对劳动力市场与政策选择的含义。

items.title_en: Goes-19 weather satellite enters Safe Hold mode
items.title_zh: GOES-19 天气卫星进入安全待机模式
items.summary_en: GOES-19 has entered Safe Hold mode after a detected anomaly, pausing normal ops. In Safe Hold, the satellite conserves power and awaits ground control to restore full operations, potentially reducing near-term weather data.
items.summary_zh: GOES-19 天气卫星因检测到异常进入安全待机模式，暂停常规操作。处于安全待机状态时，卫星会节省能源并等待地面控制重新启动全性能作业，可能短暂影响近实时天气数据的获取。

items.title_en: How to Train a Gen AI Kick Drum Model on Your Old Linux Desktop with 6GB VRAM
items.title_zh: 在 6GB VRAM 的旧 Linux 桌面上训练生成式 AI 的踢鼓模型
items.summary_en: A guide showing how to train a generative AI kick-drum model on a consumer-grade GPU (6GB VRAM) using compact architectures and optimization tricks. It demonstrates that hobbyist hardware can still produce tangible audio synthesis with the right techniques.
items.summary_zh: 一篇指南展示如何在仅有 6GB VRAM 的消费级显卡上，结合紧凑架构与优化技巧，训练一个踢鼓声生成模型。通过这些方法，业余硬件也能实现可用的音频合成。

items.title_en: Brain implant helps paralysed man to feed himself and drink from cup
items.title_zh: 脑机植入帮助瘫痪男子自行进食并从杯子中饮水
items.summary_en: A neural implant enabled a paralysed man to feed himself and drink from a cup, highlighting advances in brain–computer interfaces and assistive technology, with meaningful improvements to independence and quality of life.
items.summary_zh: 脑机接口植入使瘫痪男子能够自行进食并从杯中饮水，展示了脑–机接口和辅助技术的进步，并对自主性与生活质量带来积极影响。

items.title_en: The privacy problems hidden in your period tracker
items.title_zh: 月经追踪应用隐藏的隐私问题
items.summary_en: The piece uncovers privacy risks from period-tracking apps, detailing how sensitive health data can be collected, shared, and monetized. It offers guidance on privacy controls and safer usage.
items.summary_zh: 本文揭示月经追踪应用的隐私风险，详述敏感健康数据如何被收集、共享与变现，并提供隐私控制与更安全使用的建议。

items.title_en: M 3.9 Experimental Explosion – 147 Km ENE of Ponce Inlet, Florida
items.title_zh: 佛州附近发生 3.9 级地震：距 Ponce Inlet 东北 147 公里
items.summary_en: A magnitude 3.9 earthquake occurred 147 km ENE of Ponce Inlet, Florida. It was shallow and unlikely to cause damage, but the event informs local seismic hazard understanding in a region not known for strong earthquakes.
items.summary_zh: 佛州 Ponce Inlet 以东 147 公里处发生 3.9 级地震，震源较浅，短时内无明显损害。此事件有助于更新该区域的地震风险评估和监测工作。

items.title_en: Let's Build PlanetScale from Scratch: Infrastructure
items.title_zh: 从零开始探建 PlanetScale：基础设施
items.summary_en: An infrastructure-focused write-up explains how to build a PlanetScale-like backend from scratch, covering sharding, migrations, and schema management. It offers practical patterns for a scalable, multi-tenant database stack.
items.summary_zh: 本文从零开始探讨构建类似 PlanetScale 的基础设施，涉及分片、迁移与模式管理等要点，提供面向高可用和多租户场景的实用设计范式。

items.title_en: British Steel taken into public ownership to protect 'vital' UK supply
items.title_zh: 英国钢铁公司国有化以保护关键供应
items.summary_en: British Steel has been brought into public ownership to safeguard a vital UK supply chain. The move signals a rare state-aid-driven intervention in critical industry.
items.summary_zh: 英国钢铁公司被国有化以保障关键供应链，显示出在关键产业中的“国家干预”信号与影响。

items.title_en: Show HN: Mojibake – A low-level Unicode library written in C
items.title_zh: Show HN: Mojibake——用 C 编写的低级 Unicode 库
items.summary_en: Mojibake is a compact, low-level Unicode library in C, designed for robust text handling with careful encoding normalization and performance-sensitive paths.
items.summary_zh: Mojibake 是一个用 C 编写的紧凑型低级 Unicode 库，专注于稳健的文本处理、编码规范与高性能路径。

items.title_en: Schema Harness Achieves ~99% on Arc‑AGI‑3 Public
items.title_zh: Schema Harness 在 Arc-AGI-3 公共基准上约 99%
items.summary_en: Schema Harness claims around 99% performance on Arc-AGI-3 public benchmark, signaling strong results for schema-based reasoning systems and adding to the debate about scaling data-guided AI.
items.summary_zh: Schema Harness 在 Arc-AGI-3 公共基准上约获 99% 的表现，显示基于模式推理系统的强劲性能，并为数据驱动 AI 的扩展性讨论提供新证据。

items.title_en: Ring-Zero: Scaling Zero RL to a Trillion Parameters for Emergent Reasoning
items.title_zh: Ring-Zero：将万亿参数用于涌现式推理的零样本强化学习
items.summary_en: Ring-Zero scales zero-shot RL to trillion-parameter levels to study emergent reasoning capabilities, addressing training and infrastructure challenges while outlining implications for future AI systems.
items.summary_zh: Ring-Zero 将零样本强化学习扩展至万亿参数规模，探索涌现式推理能力，同时讨论训练难点、计算资源和对未来AI系统的影响。

items.title_en: CVE-2026-25089: FortiSandbox unauthenticated command injection added to CISA KEV
items.title_zh: CVE-2026-25089：FortiSandbox 未认证命令注入漏洞
items.summary_en: FortiSandbox has an unauthenticated command-injection vulnerability assigned CVE-2026-25089, highlighting risk for appliances and software relying on Fortinet's sandboxing. Users should apply patches and audit exposure.
items.summary_zh: 披露 CVE-2026-25089：FortiSandbox 出现未认证的命令注入漏洞，影响依赖 Fortinet 沙箱技术的系统。请尽快更新并评估暴露面。

items.title_en: Abstracting Effects with Continuations
items.title_zh: 用 Continuations 抽象化效果
items.summary_en: An exploration of abstracting effects with continuations, showing how to separate effectful behavior from syntax.
items.summary_zh: 探讨如何用 Continuations 抽象化副作用，展示将副作用行为与语法分离的方法。内容讨论模块化推理、效果处理器及对语言设计的潜在影响。

items.title_en: Timeline Scan – AI fixes the dates on your scanned photos
items.title_zh: Timeline Scan：AI 为扫描照片纠正日期
items.summary_en: Timeline Scan uses AI to estimate and fix dates for scanned photos, helping users organize archives and streamline photo curation.
items.summary_zh: Timeline Scan 使用 AI 根据图像内容与上下文线索估算并校正扫描照片的日期，帮助用户整理档案并提升照片整理效率。

items.title_en: Launch HN: Traceforce (YC S26) – Company-wide security monitoring for AI apps
items.title_zh: Traceforce（YC S26）— 面向全公司对 AI 应用的安全监控
items.summary_en: Traceforce is YC S26-backed security-monitoring startup for AI applications that aims to watch across an organization for misuse and data leakage. The product targets enterprise-scale governance as AI use expands.
items.summary_zh: Traceforce 是 YC S26 背景的 AI 应用安全监控初创公司，面向企业层面监控滥用与数据泄露。随着 AI 使用扩张，其治理需求日益突出。

items.title_en: UIUC AI Teaching Assistant
items.title_zh: UIUC 的人工智能教学助理
items.summary_en: UIUC released an AI teaching assistant project aiming to answer student questions and provide explanations, potentially reducing grading workload and scaling support in large courses.
items.summary_zh: UIUC 发布的 AI 教学助理项目旨在自动回答学生提问并给出讲解，可能减轻助教工作量并提升大规模课程的学习支持。

items.title_en: Lingbot-map: A 3D foundation model for reconstructing scenes from streaming data
items.title_zh: Lingbot-map：从流数据重建场景的 3D 基础模型
items.summary_en: Lingbot-map introduces a 3D foundation model that reconstructs scenes from streaming data, enabling real-time mapping for robotics, AR/VR, and digital twins.
items.summary_zh: Lingbot-map 引入一个从流数据重建场景的 3D 基础模型，支持实时三维映射，适用于机器人、AR/VR 与数字孪生等场景。

items.title_en: Solod: Go can be a better C
items.title_zh: Solod：Go 可能比 C 更适合系统编程
items.summary_en: Solod argues that Go, with safer memory management and productive tooling, can outperform C for many systems-programming tasks when used with careful unsafe code and zero-cost abstractions. The piece outlines a path for Go to supplant C in some domains.
items.summary_zh: Solod 认为在多种系统编程场景下，Go 具备更安全的内存管理与高效的工具链，若在需要时谨慎使用 unsafe 和零成本抽象，Go 也能超越 C 的生产力。文章勾勒了 Go 在部分领域替代 C 的可行路线。

items.title_en: Pseudpocalypse
items.title_zh: 伪信息危机
items.summary_en: A critical look at how pseudoscience and misinformation seep into tech culture, creating a credibility crisis for data and AI claims. It argues for stronger verification, transparency, and responsible design.
items.summary_zh: 对伪科学与错误信息如何渗透科技文化进行批判性审视，揭示数据与 AI 论断的信任危机，并主张加强验证、透明度与负责任的设计。

items.title_en: An Engineer's Guide to USB Typе-С (2024)
items.title_zh: 工程师指南：USB Type-C（2024）
items.summary_en: Texas Instruments updates engineers on USB-C with a 2024 guide covering connectors, PD negotiation, and safe cable design. It dives into power delivery, alt-modes, and common pitfalls to help teams design compliant, robust USB-C devices and accessories.
items.summary_zh: TI 的这份面向工程师的 USB-C 指南（2024 版）解说了连接器、供电协商与替代模式等要点。提供设计要点，帮助硬件团队确保兼容性、可靠性及安全性。

items.title_en: Show HN: Clx – Compile Lua to Native Executables Through C++20
items.title_zh: Show HN: Clx——用 C++20 将 Lua 编译成原生可执行
items.summary_en: Clx compiles Lua to native executables using C++20, enabling fast startup and fewer runtime dependencies, useful for embedding Lua logic in larger pipelines or standalone apps.
items.summary_zh: Clx 使用 C++20 将 Lua 编译为本地可执行文件，提升启动速度、降低运行时依赖，适合在大规模工程或独立应用中嵌入 Lua 逻辑。

items.title_en: Turn your singing voice into printable notes (in the browser)
items.title_zh: 在浏览器中将你的歌声转为可打印的乐谱
items.summary_en: An in-browser tool that converts singing voice into musical notation using pitch tracking and timing extraction to produce printable scores. Demonstrates accessible, client-side audio processing for creative workflows.
items.summary_zh: 在浏览器中运行的工具，通过音高跟踪与节拍提取将歌声转写为可打印的乐谱，展现了面向创作的前端音频处理能力。

items.title_en: Camera Chase Vehicle
items.title_zh: Camera Chase Vehicle
items.summary_en: A hardware concept featuring a gimbal-enabled rover-like device designed to chase or follow subjects for filming or robotics experiments, outlining hardware specs, control software, and potential use cases.
items.summary_zh: 介绍一个配备云台的追踪式摄像设备的硬件概念，类似于能追随目标的轮式探测载具，涵盖硬件规格、控制软件与潜在应用场景。

items.title_en: Old Icons
items.title_zh: 旧图标回顾
items.summary_en: A nostalgic look at classic UI icons, examining how aging designs balance recognizability, aesthetic, and accessibility, with lessons for modern iconography.
items.summary_zh: 回顾经典图标，分析它们如何在时间流逝中保持辨识度与审美，同时兼顾可访问性，为当代图标设计提供启示。

items.title_en: Starlink from 1984
items.title_zh: 1984 年的 Starlink
items.summary_en: Tracing Starlink-like ideas back to 1984, this piece situates the modern satellite internet project in a longer history of global-connectivity concepts, highlighting how feasibility, cost, and policy shape deployment.
items.summary_zh: 追溯到 1984 年的全球卫星互联网设想，本文将现代 Starlink 项目放在更长的全球连接历史中，强调可行性、成本与政策如何影响部署。

items.title_en: In Praise of Exhaustive Destructuring
items.title_zh: 对穷举式解构的赞美
items.summary_en: Argues for exhaustive destructuring as a practice that surfaces all cases in data handling, boosting safety and readability; includes practical examples across languages.
items.summary_zh: 作者主张在代码中使用穷举式解构以覆盖所有分支、提升安全性和可读性，并给出跨语言的实用示例。

items.title_en: Simulating everything, sort of: The promise and limits of world models
items.title_zh: 在某种程度上可以模拟一切：世界模型的前景与局限
items.summary_en: World models promise to let AI simulate broad aspects of the world, but real-world generalization, data efficiency, and robustness remain major hurdles.
items.summary_zh: 世界模型承诺让 AI 模拟广泛的世界状态，但在泛化、数据效率和鲁棒性方面仍存在明显的挑战。

items.title_en: Tannakian Reconstruction
items.title_zh: Tannakian 重构
items.summary_en: An accessible tour of Tannakian reconstruction, a concept linking algebraic groups with tensor categories in modern representation theory. The post builds intuition and hints at implications for how symmetry and categories organize algebraic data.
items.summary_zh: 对 Tannakian 重构的直观讲解，将代数群与张量范畴在现代表示论中的联系讲解清楚，帮助理解对称性与范畴如何组织代数数据及其应用。

items.title_en: How RCA Victor sold Sound Service to classrooms in 1939
items.title_zh: 1939 年 RCA Victor 如何向学校推销 Sound Service
items.summary_en: In 1939, RCA Victor marketed Sound Service to schools, illustrating early educational tech marketing and the ways classroom audio systems were integrated into curricula.
items.summary_zh: 1939 年，RCA Victor 将 Sound Service 推向学校市场，揭示早期教育科技的营销策略及课堂音响系统与课程整合的尝试。

items.title_en: 6× faster binary search: from compiled code to mechanical sympathy
items.title_zh: 6倍加速的二分查找：从编译代码到机械同情
items.summary_en: A technical dive into branchless binary search optimizations that leverage CPU features and data locality to achieve up to sixfold speedups.
items.summary_zh: 深入讲解利用分支消除、缓存友好性等技术实现的二分查找优化，在不同架构上可达到约六倍的性能提升。强调性能可移植性与底层实现的实用经验。

items.title_en: What loss.backward() actually does
items.title_zh: loss.backward() 究竟在做什么
items.summary_en: Explains how loss.backward() constructs and traverses the automatic differentiation graph, accumulates gradients, and memory management details that reveal common misunderstandings.
items.summary_zh: 解释 loss.backward() 如何构建并遍历自动微分图、累积梯度，以及相关的内存管理细节，揭示常见误解。
